title: Cost Per Ounce of Silver Investments
takeaway: Silver bars offer a significantly lower cost per ounce compared to coins.

data.label: American Silver Eagle (1 oz)
data.evidence: American Silver Eagle (1 oz): $30.00 (coin price) + custodian fees (typically $15-$25 per transaction) = $31 - $32 per ounce

data.label: Canadian Silver Maple Leaf (1 oz)
data.evidence: Canadian Silver Maple Leaf (1 oz): $31.00 (coin price) + custodian fees = $31 - $32 per ounce

data.label: Silver Round (1 kg)
data.evidence: Silver Round (1 kg): $1,200 / 1000 = $1.20 per ounce. Plus custodian fees (typically $15-$25 per transaction) = $1 - $1 per ounce

data.label: Silver Bullion Bar (1 oz)
data.evidence: Silver Bullion Bar (1 oz): $28 - $32 (bar price) + custodian fees = $30 - $35 per ounce

narration: The article compares the cost per ounce of various silver investments, highlighting that silver bars offer a more cost-effective option for accumulating significant amounts of silver.  The cost includes the price of the coin or bar plus custodian fees.  This comparison is crucial for investors considering silver within a Self-Directed IRA.
